blocks.html:
Replacement of tanks in prior code buildings may utilize an existing gravity ventilation system complying with the following:
   1.   The total net free area of supply and exhaust openings shall be equal to at least 1 percent of the floor area of the room, equally divided between the supply and exhaust; and
   2.   Independent supply and exhaust openings to the outside; or
   3.   Independent supply and exhaust ducts to the outside.
Section MC 1306: Oil Gauging
